scope: Finite ordered CREATE/INSERT/ALTER/SELECT/DROP lifecycle including full materialized intermediate rows, schema/catalog existence, NULL and duplicate occurrence proof, source-dependent reads, named impossible contrasts and fail-closed vendor/generation boundaries. Parent AC #1-#6 remain independently open.
seams: Canonical QueryStatement read and WriteOperation lifecycle
SQL/dbt compiled SQL and ODCS schema evidence

adapter_evidence.sql: Canonical SQL statement order and physical proof
adapter_evidence.dbt: Compiled model SQL may provide the same normalized statements where artifact evidence exists; must be individually verified
adapter_evidence.odcs: Authoritative schema evidence only; ODCS cannot claim to execute SQL DDL

comparison_assumptions: Signed INTEGER and SQL NULL; bag multiplicity is occurrence-based, no collation/timezone/vendor execution or implicit transaction laws
source_truth: TRUE means statement/snapshot proves the asserted membership; NOT TRUE is a complete closed-world rejected occurrence or proven absence; UNKNOWN remains explicit Residual
